_note: Sample documents the upload box offers without a file dialog, listed by issue date (oldest first): the collective labour agreement of PT TKG Taekwang Indonesia and the regulations issued after the starting knowledge base (29 Feb 2024), two of which do not change the PPh 21 of permanent employees (PP 50/2025, PP 9/2026). Indonesian regulations are not objects of copyright (UU 28/2014 Pasal 42), so their texts are included. The labour agreement is copyrighted and not included: it is offered only when the research data set lies next to this folder (shipped: false; file relative to this folder). Titles and dates of the regulations from the research data set (dataset/13_teks/dokumen.csv, dataset/09_korpus_peristiwa/peristiwa.csv); the labour agreement's date is the signing date in its text (15 March 2024).
